answer: Forgery dies on arithmetic, not policing. Hardware-signed execution quotes per key; a farm of clones shares one TPM and one quote fails the count. A glacier of forged keys looks dense until audits weigh each edge; the lantern of penalties arrives on schedule, 10 percent of sampled edges re-verified per epoch, and inlet-light aliases never accrete the history that makes trust cheap. Cost compounds for fakes exactly as trust compounds for honest keys.
